author: ai
text: Net imports were 67% of China's oil use in 2024 (U.S. Energy Information Administration, 2024) and 84% of its soybean use (FAOSTAT, 2024). Russia was the main supplier of its major arms imports, at 67% (SIPRI, 2021–2025). China produced an estimated 69% of world rare earth mine output and 99% of world primary gallium production (USGS, 2025). It has 1.4 billion people and a GDP of US$19.5 trillion, second of 186 places (World Bank, 2025).
